findings.title: Resolve met by proof and turned aside
findings.claim: The two inward movements named in the focus meet a perceived Lord-sourced proof, and the divine turning-away carries Yusuf away from the paired harms before the attempted course becomes an accomplished act.
findings.mechanism: The repeated resolve form supplies the forming-intention carrier. Wider records give independent threshold patterns for an intention stopped short, clear seeing after a satanic touch, Lord-sourced proof as illumination, and protective removal of harm; the focus conditional and purpose construction bind those contacts into a redirected trajectory.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the ayah as a threshold sequence in which intention, apprehension, and divine redirection meet before completion, while the two agents' clauses remain distinct.
findings.containment: The finding does not decide whether the two hamma clauses have identical moral status, does not identify the content of the proof, and does not claim that any external parallel is the same event as the focus scene.

epistemic.reason: The focus relation and all four branches are directly anchored by a trusted cross-run publication. The wider connection rows supply exact target Arabic but explicitly lack target morphology and remain discovery nominations, so the global extension is qualified.

findings.title: Two named harms under protective turning
findings.claim: The divine turning in the focus addresses two coordinated but distinct objects, broad harm and extreme indecency, so protection reaches both consequence and boundary-crossing pressure.
findings.mechanism: The focus turning verb takes al-suu and al-fahshaa as separate coordinated objects. The wider 2:169 connection repeats the pair under a command, supplying an independent moral-pressure frame that sharpens why the ayah names both.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the coordination as deliberate: one term keeps the broad harm visible while the second names a more specific severe violation.
findings.containment: The finding does not decide whether either term means internal inclination, external coercion, sexual act, public exposure, or another live facet; wider target morphology is not supplied.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk support explicitly preserves the two objects, but its source identity is legacy-unbound. The 2:169 connection supplies exact target Arabic while its target morphology remains unavailable.

findings.title: Protection continuing as practice
findings.claim: The focus's protective diversion can remain an ongoing reorientation: the later account ties Yusuf's outcome to guardedness and patience, making the interrupted resolve newly legible as the beginning of a sustained practice rather than a moment that simply disappears.
findings.mechanism: The focus acts of forming resolve and turning-away return through the wider 12:90 conditions of taqwa and patience. That contact extends the temporal boundary from one blocked course to an orientation maintained across trial.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold protection and vulnerability together: the intervention changes direction at the hinge, while later conduct is described as requiring durable guarded patience.
findings.containment: The finding does not claim that 12:90 repeats the focus roots, that the focus intervention guarantees later conduct, or that the reader-walk source is a fully anchored lexical analysis.

epistemic.reason: The wide reader-walk support explicitly names 12:90 and the changed temporal reading, but its reader identity is legacy-unbound. The reciprocal connection supplies exact target Arabic while target morphology remains unavailable.

findings.title: Purified status as active protection
findings.claim: The closing status word can be heard as a relational protection frame: Yusuf is named among servants set apart by God while the temptation remains a real scene.
findings.mechanism: The focus passive participle returns through the purified-servant formulas in 15:40 and 37:40, where the supplied connection rows place the set-apart group in an exception or protection frame. This makes the final qualification explain the preceding averting as divine selection and belonging rather than a generic compliment.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the closing clause as connected to the action before it: being set apart describes a protected relation within exposure to temptation, not an abstract label detached from the scene.
findings.containment: The finding does not claim complete immunity from later trials, decide every available kh-l-s facet, or infer target morphology beyond the exact wider surface texts and connection notes.

epistemic.reason: The two connections supply exact wider Arabic and an explicit purified-servant protection relation, but their metadata says target morphology is unavailable and their labels are nominations rather than decisions.

findings.title: Proof opening toward public examination
findings.claim: The Lord-sourced proof in the focus also opens toward public examination: the later inquiry into the women and their admission make the encounter answerable to testimony, while Yusuf's withdrawal remains a claim about what occurred before the inquiry.
findings.mechanism: The focus proof and protective turning return through 12:50's request for inquiry, 12:51's admission and attestation of Yusuf's truthfulness, and 12:54's public trust after speaking with him. The wider sequence changes the proof from a private interruption alone into an event with an accountable social afterlife.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why the proof matters beyond the instant of temptation: it supports a later route of examination and trust without erasing the unresolved interior dimensions of the encounter.
findings.containment: The focus proof is not identified with a later shirt or testimony, the later inquiry does not settle every reading of the focus, and the wider target morphology is not supplied.

epistemic.reason: The three reciprocal connections provide exact wider Arabic and explicit inquiry, admission, and trust relations, but their metadata requires fresh assessment and supplies no target morphology.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The proof changes the course in the room and also remains capable of supporting public examination afterward.
